title: Workspace owner Root Workspace canonical Brand create lifecycle

phases.objective: Allow an authenticated workspace owner/admin to create or idempotently reuse a canonical Brand from an explicit personal/company Root Workspace, while atomically converging Brand identity, tenant authority, operational Brand workspace, Root-to-Brand container topology, direct closure, creator grant, and container authority epoch without treating the operational workspace or route tenant id as ownership authority.

e2e_journeys.actor: Authenticated workspace owner or admin operating from a personal or company Root Workspace
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: POST /me/workspaces/{tenant_id}/brands with root_workspace_id and display_name or brand_name
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The explicit Root Workspace is resolved and tenant-matched before mutation, then revalidated under lock inside the canonical container-authority transaction; canonical Brand identity, tenant link, operational Brand workspace, creator admin grant, Root Workspace container, Brand container, exactly one Root-to-Brand contains edge, and direct closure converge before commit. The operational workspace remains a child binding rather than an authority root, a different real Root parent fails closed, and the legacy projection consumes the same Root hint instead of recreating operational-workspace ownership.
steps: Require root_workspace_id and resolve exactly one active Root Workspace before lifecycle mutation.
Require the Root Workspace tenant to match the tenant_id compatibility route scope; reject cross-tenant roots before mutation.

Revalidate the Root Workspace under lock inside the canonical container-authority transaction; require workspace_ownership_type personal or company, reject workspace_type=brand as a Root, require bootstrap_status ready, and require a personal Root owner to match the signed-in user.
Normalize the requested display name and derive deterministic tenant-scoped Brand creation identity.
Revalidate exactly one active owner/admin membership with a locking read inside the transaction.
Reuse or create exactly one active canonical brands row.
Create or repair an active tenant_brand_links row with workspace_owner_brand_create provenance.

Create or reuse a deterministic workspace_registry operational Brand workspace bound by linked_brand_key, keep workspace_type=brand and ownership unclassified, and persist root_workspace_id only as a projection/provenance hint.
Create or repair only the creator's explicit brand/admin workspace grant.
Ensure canonical Root Workspace and Brand containers use the same deterministic identities as the projection service.

Accept only an existing Root-to-Brand contains edge that matches the selected Root; archive only a clearly identified legacy_projection parent from the operational Brand workspace; reject any other active inheritance-bearing parent instead of silently reparenting the Brand.
Create the deterministic Root Workspace container to Brand container contains relationship when absent.

Rebuild container_closure inside the same mutation transaction using the pending authority epoch and require one direct unambiguous Root-to-Brand path with shortest_depth=1, longest_depth=1, and path_count=1 before commit.
Advance the tenant container_authority_epoch, commit once, and invalidate the container authority cache after successful commit.

Require dynamicContainerProjectionService to consume workspace_registry.config_json.root_workspace_id for operational Brand workspaces and never fall back to making the operational workspace the Brand authority parent.
Register the Brand Create and Root topology regressions in the canonical test manifest and exact frontend operation evidence.

Generate the Brand Create state_change rule only when route, runtime auth, Root authority, transaction, locked owner authority, canonical identity, tenant link, operational Brand workspace, creator grant, exact topology readback, no-secret response, and registered operation test evidence all pass.
Require generated operation governance, frontend dispatch, and runtime route evidence to match the final source tree through the governed generated-artifact lifecycle.
assertions: Missing root_workspace_id fails closed before Brand lifecycle mutation.
A cross-tenant Root Workspace is rejected before Brand lifecycle mutation even if the caller has authority in another tenant.
A Root Workspace classified as workspace_type=brand or without personal/company workspace_ownership_type is rejected.
A personal Root Workspace can be used only by its exact owner; a company Root Workspace still requires the existing active owner/admin tenant authority.
A non-owner/admin or missing/inactive membership fails closed before Brand lifecycle mutation.
Equivalent Brand names within one tenant are idempotent while the same display name in another tenant does not collide.
Operational Brand Workspace identity is deterministic, workspace_type=brand, linked_brand_key equals canonical Brand target_key, and it does not become a Root ownership authority surface.
Brand Workspace ambiguity/collision fails closed before creator-grant mutation.
The creator alone receives the explicit Brand admin grant; creation does not grant all workspace members access.
tenant_brand_links uses workspace_owner_brand_create authority provenance rather than historical projection provenance.
workspace_resource_grants uses existing owner_assignment source and bounded workspace_brand_create metadata.
The Brand container has exactly one active ancestry/inheritance-bearing Workspace parent and that parent is the selected Root Workspace container.
A different real Root parent is never silently replaced; the transaction fails closed with a topology conflict.
Only a legacy_projection edge from the unclassified operational Brand workspace may be disabled when the canonical Root replacement is explicit and verified.
Root-to-Brand closure readback is one direct path with shortest_depth=1, longest_depth=1, and path_count=1 before commit.
Brand Create and legacy projection derive identical deterministic container and relationship identities.
Projection with a missing or invalid root_workspace_id records a high-severity held issue and emits no fallback Brand containment edge from the operational Brand workspace.
Idempotent retries converge on the same Brand, operational workspace, Root-to-Brand relationship, and direct closure without creating a second authority path.
The operation-governance generator fails closed when required Brand Create evidence is missing.

With complete evidence, Brand Create is classified state_change with runtime authorization, canonical container-authority transaction, exact topology readback before commit, parameter bindings, and registered test evidence.
Generated frontend dispatch contains no operation_classification_gap for Brand Create.
No Migration Apply, live Production SQL mutation, Production/provider mutation, deployment, credential/secret access, force push, or external send occurs in CI.
